::api-operation{method="GET" path="/v1/businesses/{biz}/customer_segments/preview"}
#docs
Takes the customer list's own `field[op]=value` grammar verbatim, so previewing a segment and listing customers are the same request shape. Validated against the same allow-list a saved segment is, so a preview cannot succeed where the save would fail. With no filters it answers for every customer.

## Path parameters

| Parameter | Type | Required | Description |
|---|---|---|---|
| `biz` | `string` | **yes** | Business id (biz_…) |

## Query parameters

| Parameter | Type | Required | Description |
|---|---|---|---|
| `limit` | `integer` | no | Maximum number of customers to return. |
| `starting_after` | `string` | no | Opaque cursor from a previous `next_cursor`. |

## Response

| Field | Type | Description |
|---|---|---|
| `object` | `string` | The object type; always `list`. One of `list`. |
| `data` | `array of object` | The rows on this page. |
| `data.credit_settings` | `object` | Credit policy for this customer: an override of what happens when credit is used up (ignored after `override_expires_at`), and an overdraft limit per currency. Replaced whole; null = the business's settings. |
| `data.object` | `string` | The object type. |
| `data.id` | `string` | The customer's id (cus_…). |
| `data.email` | `string` | The customer's email address. |
| `data.name` | `string` | DERIVED, read-only (deprecated 2026-08-23): `first_name last_name`, else `company`, else null. There is no `customer.name` any more — sending this field to create or update returns 400. It is emitted only so a caller has a flat display string. Two distinct identities exist and neither is derived from the other: `first_name`/`last_name`/`company` are the ACCOUNT HOLDER (lists, emails, portal greeting), while `address.first_name`/`last_name`/`company` are the BILLING CONTACT, which is what gets printed on invoices and credit notes and sent to the gateway as the billing name. |
| `data.currency` | `string` | The currency the operator pinned on the customer, if any. Prefer effective_currency when deciding what to transact in. |
| `data.effective_currency` | `string` | DERIVED, read-only: the currency to transact in — `currency` when the operator set one, else the currency of the customer's live (active/in_trial) subscriptions, highest MRR winning a tie. Emitted by GET (detail) and by the list; absent from create/patch/archive responses. Null when there is nothing to derive from — fall back to the business default. Never write it back to `currency`. |
| `data.lifetime_revenue` | `array of object` | DERIVED, read-only: cash collected from this customer, one entry per currency — succeeded payments minus succeeded refunds. Credits applied to invoices are not cash and are excluded. Emitted by GET (detail) only. |
| `data.tax_exempt` | `boolean` | True if the customer is exempt from tax. |
| `data.email_notifications` | `boolean` | Whether the customer gets billing emails. |
| `data.marketing_opt_in` | `boolean` | The customer's answer to the marketing opt-in at checkout. Null when they were never asked. |
| `data.marketing_opt_in_at` | `string · ISO-8601` | The marketing opt in time (ISO-8601 UTC). |
| `data.dunning_excluded` | `boolean` | True if the customer is excluded from dunning. |
| `data.exclude_from_reporting` | `boolean` | True if the customer is left out of metrics and reports. |
| `data.billing_cc_emails` | `array of string` | Addresses copied on the customer's invoice and receipt emails. |
| `data.billing_bcc_emails` | `array of string` | Addresses blind-copied on the customer's invoice and receipt emails. |
| `data.tax_behavior` | `string` | Whether every taxed line for this customer is inclusive or exclusive. Null = each price decides. One of `inclusive`, `exclusive`. |
| `data.dunning_policy` | `string` | The customer's dunning policy. |
| `data.vat_number` | `string` | The customer's VAT number. |
| `data.withholding_rate_bps` | `integer` | The withholding rate on the customer's payments, in basis points (100 = 1%). |
| `data.custom_fields` | `object` | Stored custom-field values; also flattened onto the object as cf_&lt;name&gt; |
| `data.segment_facts` | `object` | Per-customer figures the segment table renders: `statuses` counts subscriptions by API status (so `non_renewing` appears, as it does on the subscriptions list), and `mrr` maps ISO code → integer minor units over the earning ones. |
| `has_more` | `boolean` | Whether more rows exist after this page. |
| `next_cursor` | `string` | Pass as `starting_after` to get the next page. Null on the last page. |
| `next_offset` | `string` | Present only while has_more; the same opaque token as next_cursor — pass as offset |
| `total` | `integer` | Total number of matching customers. |
| `segment` | `string` | The segment's id (seg_…), or null for a preview. |
| `mrr_by_currency` | `object` | Total MRR of the matching customers per currency, in minor units. |

## Status codes

| Status | Meaning |
|---|---|
| `200` | Success |
| `400` | Invalid or refused filter set |

#request
```bash [Request]
curl "$TMBILLING_URL/v1/businesses/biz_XXXXXXXXXXXX01/customer_segments/preview?limit=10" \
  -H "Authorization: Bearer $TMBILLING_API_KEY"
```
